title: Finance Pre-Close
description: Daily pre-close for the month end: forecast of revenue, gross profit and EBIT per company code with a range, bridge to the budget, close calendar, open items, accrual proposals, alerts and what-if scenarios, on mockup data.
insights: Fictional group and mockup data in the shape of an S/4HANA Finance extract; no finance system or MCP server is connected. A generator creates the figures.
Move through the 22 working days of the month: the forecast, its range, the open items, the close tasks and the alerts change with the day.
A person approves every accrual; the app only simulates posting. Joule explains variances and writes the daily briefing.
'Start demo' walks through six steps for one pre-close day.
prompt: Bundled example: Finance Pre-Close (static, mockup data embedded by npm run sync:finance-preclose).
